travis_livingAreaSqft.rootCauseIdentified: TCAD's certified appraisal export is a base-roll product carrying only improvement dollar values, never area. Living area lives in a separate improvement-DETAIL file (field imprv_det_area, in APPRAISAL_IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL.TXT/IMP_DET.TXT per the shared True Automation PACS export layout), and that file's presence in a given CD build is optional per the layout spec's own documentation. The most likely mechanism is that the ingest pulled the certified export only, which never contained the file the field lives in -- not a null value on a queried field.

fleetMemory: LESSON: Texas CAD 'certified appraisal export' products commonly omit improvement-area detail by design -- the True Automation PACS layout spec states the improvement-detail file's inclusion depends on export-build options. Any Texas county reading livingAreaSqft as zero-at-source should be checked against this pattern (a separate improvement-detail product) before treating it as a data absence.

LESSON: TCAD does not publish its own machine-readable layout spec for the 'Improvement Details Report' product (unlike its certified/supplemental exports, which link an Export Layouts doc) -- a peer CAD's copy of the shared statewide layout family is the practical way to read the field names.
